inputs.prompt: Animate this exact hand-drawn 2D Japanese anime frame. Preserve ink outlines, hard-edged cel shading, flat matte skin, broad hair locks and painted gothic backgrounds throughout. Preserve identities, clothing, number of characters and established scenery. Intentional animation with anticipation, force, follow-through and settle; no loop, CGI, extra limbs, character morphing, unrelated cut, orbit or unmotivated zoom. Kimi holds her left light crescent blade beside her shoulder for a brief focused breath, eyes fixed on the central window. She rotates her torso slightly, then throws the LEFT pale blade decisively toward screen right and slightly forward into the window. The blade leaves her fingers completely. Her left hand follows through open and then lowers. The other dark crescent blade stays securely in her right hand, not duplicated. Hair and skirt follow the torso twist. A tiny forward push on the anticipation, stop camera movement at the release. No circle, portal, unnecessary flourish or repeated throw.
